origin: Reload Swiss online loading data (Nitrochemie; loads, V5 velocities, pressures; scripts/data/loaddata)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 96 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (9 cartridges), velocity error 9.8 % rms, pressure error 31 % rms (published pressures). Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the type (single/double base) is not published, double-base assumed because it fits the velocities better), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data. Handgun or shotgun powder: the model is made for rifle pressures, so the errors are larger than for rifle powders. Fewer data or a poorer fit than most other records (see the quality Qlty): use with more caution.
